issues.message: 417 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Good inside (long table with benches, hearth, smoker corner, kegs) and trapdoor shutters, but the outside is plain for a 13x15 hall: no boxes, lanterns or props yet.
notes.purpose: The floor plan reads as a tavern (long table, kegs, hearth); from outside it is just a big timber house until L2's sign.
notes.roof: Steep spruce roof, 1-block dark oak eave all round (x3/x11 and z1/z13 at y4), slab ridge, dormer; no overhang warning on this level.
notes.life: No plants or lanterns at L1; only a mossy patch in the plinth.
notes.materials: Cobble/stone-brick base, dark oak frame, white terracotta infill, spruce roof, brick chimney: clean Style A.

visual.summary: The shell of a long timber food hall: stone plinth, dark oak frame, steep spruce roof with a dormer, an outside brick chimney at the back, and inside a long table, hearth, smoker and kegs.
problems: Chimney ends at y7 (z13), one below the ridge (y8): raise it one or two blocks so it clears the roof line (L2/L3 put a campfire on it at y8, level with the ridge).
Reach: 162 of 270 standing places reached; the unreached ones are roof slopes, the ridge and two chimney-side brick tops at y4 z13: the whole floor and every room are reached, fine.

visual.summary: L1 is the working food hall shell: long timber hall with a long table under the dormer, brick hearth and chimney, a smoker kitchen corner and a keg bar. The only change from v1 is the chimney now rising to the ridge.
problems: Reach: 162 of 269 standing places reached; the unreached ones are main roof slopes, the ridge, and the two chimney-side brick tops at y4 z13; the whole floor, kitchen are reached: fine.
